license_required.quote: No person shall practice optometry in this Commonwealth or hold himself or herself out as being able to do so unless he or she is the holder of a license duly issued to him or her by the board

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners

name.quote: "Board" means the Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners

type.quote: The Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners shall consist of five (5) members appointed by the Governor.

age_minimum.quote: The applicant is not less than eighteen (18) years of age and is of good moral character

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant is not less than eighteen (18) years of age and is of good moral character

degree_required.value: Doctor of Optometry (O.D.) from an accredited school or college of optometry
degree_required.quote: The applicant is a graduate of a school or college of optometry that is accredited by a regional or professional accreditation organization that is recognized or approved by the council on postsecondary accreditation, or by the United States Department of Education, and is in good standing, as approved by the board.

accrediting_body.value: Regional or professional accreditation organization recognized or approved by the council on postsecondary accreditation or by the United States Department of Education

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO) or board-approved examination

exams.quote: Accept the scores of the applicant from an examination prepared, administered, and graded by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or any other organization approved by the board as qualified to administer the examination

exams.name: Kentucky optometric law examination
exams.notes: Board may require passage of an examination on Kentucky optometric law
exams.quote: Require passage of an examination on Kentucky optometric law.

interval_years.quote: All optometrists desiring to continue practice shall annually, prior to March 1, secure from the secretary-treasurer of the board a renewal certificate

required.quote: all optometrists now or hereafter licensed in the Commonwealth of Kentucky are and shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of optometry

hours_per_period.quote: shall not exceed eight (8) hours in any calendar year, with the exception of those optometrists who are authorized to prescribe therapeutic agents who shall be required to have additional credit hours of continuing education in ocular therapy and pharmacology, the amount of required credit hours to be determined by the board, but not to exceed an additional seventeen (17) credit hours, for a total not to exceed twenty-five (25) credit hours per year

available.quote: The board may license by endorsement an optometrist who holds a valid license that was obtained by examination from another state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Must have engaged in active practice for at least 5 years immediately preceding application, have no pending board actions or malpractice suits, meet all qualifications for regular state licensure, and submit application with fee not to exceed $700

scope_protection.quote: To practice optometry, directly or indirectly, or to hold oneself out as being able so to do without first having obtained a license from the board

definition_quote.value: The evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or surgical, nonsurgical, or related treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the eye and its appendages and their impact on the human body provided by an optometrist within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience and in accordance with this chapter, the ethics of the profession, and applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: The evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or surgical, nonsurgical, or related treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the eye and its appendages and their impact on the human body provided by an optometrist within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience and in accordance with this chapter, the ethics of the profession, and applicable law.

value: examination, diagnosis, and treatment of the human eye and its appendages
prescribing and adapting lenses, contact lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, prisms, ocular devices
all routes of administration of pharmaceutical agents as authorized
vision therapy or orthoptics
low vision rehabilitation
laser surgery procedures (excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK)
surgical procedures not excluded by statute
preoperative and postoperative care of excluded procedures
methods_authorized.quote: Prescribing and adapting lenses, contact lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, prisms, ocular devices, and all routes of administration of pharmaceutical agents, as authorized by KRS 320.240; or Employing vision therapy or orthoptics, low vision rehabilitation, and laser surgery procedures, excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK.

drug_authority.value: Therapeutically certified optometrists may administer diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (miotics for emergency use, mydriatics, cycloplegics, topical anesthetics) and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents including oral medications except Schedule I controlled substances and Schedule II controlled substances other than hydrocodone combination products; Schedule II hydrocodone and Schedule III-V controlled substances limited to 72-hour supply with no refills.
drug_authority.quote: Any therapeutically certified optometrist licensed under the provisions of this subsection shall be authorized to prescribe oral medications, except any controlled substances classified in Schedule I and any controlled substances classified in Schedule II other than hydrocodone combination products as defined in KRS 218A.010, for any condition which an optometrist is authorized to treat under the provisions of this chapter.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Nonlaser surgery related to removal of the eye from a living human being

surgery_definition.value: Certain nonlaser and laser surgical procedures are excluded from optometric scope, including removal of the eye, full thickness incision/excision of cornea or sclera (except emergency paracentesis), penetrating/lamellar keratoplasty, incision of iris/ciliary body/vitreous/retina, surgical extraction of crystalline lens, intraocular implants, incisional/excisional surgery of extraocular muscles, eyelid surgery for malignancies or cosmetic/mechanical repair, bony orbit surgery, lacrimal system surgery (except probing), full thickness conjunctivoplasty with graft/flap, any nonlaser procedure not correcting ocular abnormalities, posterior chamber injection for macular/retinal disease, and general anesthesia.
surgery_definition.quote: The following procedures are excluded from the scope of practice of optometry, except for the preoperative and postoperative care of these procedures

value: laser surgery procedures (excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK)
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: laser surgery procedures, excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK

value: paracentesis in an emergency situation requiring immediate reduction of the pressure inside the eye
lacrimal probing or related procedures
correction and relief of ocular abnormalities by surgical procedures not excluded
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Nonlaser surgery requiring full thickness incision or excision of the cornea or sclera other than paracentesis in an emergency situation requiring immediate reduction of the pressure inside the eye

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: The board may authorize only those persons who have qualified for use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents as set out in subsection (12) of this section to utilize and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in the examination or treatment of any condition of the eye or its appendages.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: The use of injections for other than treatment of the human eye and its appendages shall be limited to the administration of benadryl, epinephrine, or equivalent medication to counteract anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reaction.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Employing vision therapy or orthoptics, low vision rehabilitation, and laser surgery procedures, excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK.

immunization_authority.quote: In a public health emergency, the commissioner of health may authorize therapeutically licensed optometrists to administer inoculation for systemic health reasons.

value: Schedule I controlled substances prohibited

The authority to prescribe a Schedule II hydrocodone combination product as defined in KRS 218A.010 and a Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substance shall be limited to prescriptions for a quantity sufficient to provide treatment for up to seventy-two (72) hours.

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: The authority to prescribe a Schedule II hydrocodone combination product as defined in KRS 218A.010 and a Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substance shall be limited to prescriptions for a quantity sufficient to provide treatment for up to seventy-two (72) hours.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Any therapeutically certified optometrist licensed under the provisions of this subsection shall be authorized to prescribe oral medications, except any controlled substances classified in Schedule I and any controlled substances classified in Schedule II other than hydrocodone combination products

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: An optometrist shall not administer drugs, prescribe drugs, or perform laser or nonlaser surgery procedures until he or she is licensed by the board. Any therapeutically licensed optometrist authorized to practice under this section shall meet the educational and competence criteria set forth by the board in order to perform expanded therapeutic procedures.

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: When the board has reason to believe, based upon its own information or a complaint or inquiry directed to the board, that an optometrist is suffering from a physical or mental condition that might impede his ability to practice competently, the board may order the optometrist to undergo a physical or mental examination

retired_license_status_available.quote: The administrative regulations shall include the classification and licensure of optometrists by examination or credentials, retirement of a license, and reinstatement of a license.
